series_description: A thrilling, high-stakes narrative following Donald's desperate and harrowing escape from a dangerous life in Texas to the imposing, secure sanctuary of Ashley Tower. This story is a tense exploration of survival, trauma, and the lengths one will go to protect the people they love in a world that offers no easy ways out.
